basic_info.description: This magnificent 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom Presidio Heights condo delivers on all fronts - elegant city living within steps from home, an open floor plan, turn key condition, parking and outdoor space.  The front of the residence features high design and a functional open layout.  The recently remodeled chef's kitchen showcases a wolf range, high end quartz counters, custom cabinetry and ample storage all rich in design and feel.  All 3 of the bedrooms are in the rear of the residence and the primary suite is outfitted with an en-suite bathroom and private deck offering quiet, city outlooks.  The 2nd full bathroom, laundry area, garage parking for 1 car and a rear shared turf yard round out this beautiful offering.
